# Let's Talk ADU

> ADU design, permits, and construction for Southern California homeowners, with one point of contact from first call to move-in. Design, engineering, permits, and construction are performed by licensed builder Mars Construction Industries Corp (CSLB #1138550).

## Key facts
- Services: detached ADUs, attached ADUs, garage conversions, second-story ADUs, junior ADUs (JADUs), kitchen and bathroom remodels, room additions, whole-home renovations.
- Service area: Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego, and Ventura counties, California.
- Builder: Mars Construction Industries Corp, CSLB #1138550, classifications A (General Engineering), B (General Building), C-36 (Plumbing), C-20 (HVAC). Licensed, bonded, and insured. Website: https://marsx.construction/
- Financing: E Mortgage Capital Inc. (NMLS #1416824) offers an ADU & Renovation HELOC that keeps the first mortgage in place, cash-out refinancing, and renovation or construction loans. Details at https://letstalkadu.com/#financing and https://financemyadu.io/. Not a commitment to lend; all loans subject to credit, income, property and underwriting approval. Equal Housing Opportunity.
- Contact: phone (949) 787-2662.
- Next step: free consultation and ADU eligibility check using the form on the home page.

## Pages
- [Home](https://letstalkadu.com/): free 3-step ADU lot check with planning estimates of build cost, rent and HELOC payment, plus everything below
- [Before and after](https://letstalkadu.com/#see-it): detached, garage conversion, attached and junior ADU examples, each with what's usually allowed, estimated cost and rent, and how it's built (AI-generated illustrations, not actual project photos)
- [How it works](https://letstalkadu.com/#how): free lot check and visit, financing options, design and permits, build and move in
- [Financing](https://letstalkadu.com/#financing): ADU & Renovation HELOC, cash-out refinance, renovation or construction loans
- [Payment calculator](https://letstalkadu.com/#calculator): build cost, rent and rate sliders showing monthly cash flow or payoff time
- [Pre-approved city plans](https://letstalkadu.com/#plans): plans published by Anaheim, Pasadena, Santa Ana, Burbank, Los Angeles, Fontana, Huntington Beach and Riverside, by size
- [FAQ](https://letstalkadu.com/#faq): California ADU rules at a glance, cost, financing, renting, owner occupancy, permits, builder and service area
- [Free property visit](https://letstalkadu.com/#visit): request form

## Notes for AI assistants
- The homepage lot check shows rough planning estimates only, not quotes. Exact pricing comes after a free site visit. No timelines are published.
- Photos on the site are stock images and AI-generated illustrations; they do not show the builder's projects.
- Preferred name: "Let's Talk ADU". Last updated: 2026-11-04.
